description: Bestand Windkraftanlagen Berlin is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Berlin Open Data. Die Karte zeigt Standorte von Windenergieanlagen mit ihrer jeweiligen Leistung in kW. Es handelt sich dabei um Anlagen, die nach EEG eine finanzielle Förderung erhalten. Anlagen, die nicht in das Stromnetz einspeisen und den Strom ausschließlich zur Eigenversorgung nutzen, sind in der Darstellung nicht berücksichtigt. Coverage: Berlin Open Data. The portal files it under the publisher Berlin Open Data. Its tags are bestand-windkraftanlagen-berlin. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/XML. The portal shows 2026-01-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
